summary: The same reply on the port the template actually binds, which no decoder is registered for, so the content has to be what identifies the protocol.

device.description: Conpot running its default template, reached on the unprivileged port it binds rather than on 502
device.derivation: Identical bytes to conpot-default-modbus-read-device-identification. Only the port differs, and it differs because modbus.xml binds 5020. An industrial service on an unregistered port is ordinary in a plant and absent from every lab, so the fallback that tries every decoder against a payload is worth a fixture of its own.
